name: j5ik2o-ddd-cross-aggregate-constraints
description: Use when a use case wants to check another aggregate's state before changing the current aggregate. Helps separate true invariants from policies, detect Saga misuse, reason about CQRS/Event Sourcing lookup limits, and decide whether inconsistent data is acceptable. Trigger for cross-aggregate validation, checking another aggregate, command-side read-model access, reverse lookup constraints, or Saga-based validation.
